info.name: StyleConnect Admin
info.description:
Admin API for the StyleConnect dashboard. Run Auth → Admin login first; it stores {{admin_token}}. List requests store the first row's id, so detail requests work straight after.

To merge into the main collection, drag the 'Admin' folder across — auth is set on that folder, so it keeps using {{admin_token}}.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Bearer {{admin_token}} for everything inside (except Admin login).

request.description: Admins only. Non-admins get the same 422 as bad credentials. Saves the token to {{admin_token}}.

item.name: Designers
item.description: {{designer_id}} is the designer profile uuid; 'List designers' fills it in.

query.description: Business name, owner name or email

item.name: Shoppers
item.description: {{shopper_id}} is the user uuid; 'List shoppers' fills it in.

query.description: reviewed | awaiting_review (always empty — no listing approval)

request.description: Numeric review id. pending | approved | rejected.
